request.description:
Method: GET  
Endpoint: /onboarding/ariel  
Example URL: [https://api.tpet.com/onboarding/Ariel](https://api.tpet.com/onboarding/Ariel)

Path Parameter: ariel (string, required)

Headers:  
Content-Type: application/json  
Authorization: Bearer (optional)

Body: none

Response Format: JSON  
Response Example:  
{  
"name": "Ariel",  
"self_intro": "Hi! I'm Ariel, part of the 8th Tech cohort, and I will be joining the TPET team as a backend developer. I enjoy listening to K-pop and playing the piano. Looking forward to working with everyone!"  
}
